high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "wehavethedata." The post features an article headline about Anduril's new drone, which is described as offering to inject more AI into warfare. The headline reads: "Anduril’s New Drone Offers to Inject More AI Into Warfare." The accompanying text explains that a swarm of Ghost 4s, controlled by a single person on the ground, can perform reconnaissance missions like searching for enemy weapons or soldiers. Below the text, there is an image of a Ghost 4 drone, which appears to be a large, black, multi-rotor aircraft
